title: Level seven crab bomb shared closure

0x4a48e0.name: malloc
0x4a48e0.reason: the C runtime heap ends in operating-system calls

0x4a7bc0.name: _lock
0x4a7bc0.reason: C runtime lock: enters an operating-system critical section; the game is single-threaded here

0x4a7c40.name: _unlock
0x4a7c40.reason: C runtime unlock: leaves an operating-system critical section

0x4a9070.name: realloc
0x4a9070.reason: the C runtime heap ends in operating-system calls (HeapReAlloc); pairs with malloc and free

0x4f63ec.reason: the C runtime heap ends in operating-system calls

0x5469e8.name: InterlockedDecrement
0x5469e8.reason: Windows atomic reference-count operation reached by the original CString implementation.

coverage_exempt.reason: Original operator-new failure sets EDI=0 here and immediately reads [EDI] at 0x431d2e; original-only allocation-failure probe faults at address 0. No returning execution reaches this path.

Requires 0x4db6e0 to return zero. Both original realloc-failure paths set EBP=0 then call 0x4dc680, whose mov eax,[ebp+4] faults at address 4 before returning; original-only failure probe confirms this.

Second bounds miss is impossible after successful first lookup: original 0x4db6e0 with param2=0 sets the appropriate signed bound to the requested input. The in-range path changes no bounds; there is no intervening call after the first lookup. First-lookup failure faults in original 0x4dc680 before this check.
Requires second bounds-miss growth returning zero. That miss cannot occur after successful first lookup, and original growth failure faults at 0x4dc680 with EBP=0 before returning zero.

Original forces y velocity=2000 and forms vx*vx+2000*2000+vz*vz at 0x4322cb..0x4322e1. The stored coefficient is multiplied by immutable 0.25 at 0x43234b, so finite values are at least 1000000, outside immutable epsilon +/-0.1. Infinity takes quadratic branch; NaN sets C0 and takes 0x432362. Thus normalized-linear branch is unreachable with original constants.
